images_opened.tool: functions.view_image of final actual PNG; separately opened actual PDF rendered at 96 dpi and original Figure 2 reference crop
images_opened.size_basis: Adopted and measured 190 × 112 mm, Arial 8 pt; the actual 719 × 424 pixel 96 dpi PDF preview was opened, alongside the full-resolution PNG.

design_checks.evidence: The plot uses literal signed model coefficients and shared nonzero-gene counts, never measured activity or causal pathway interaction. Independent audit recomputes all 55 pairs, 48 zero overlaps, all seven nonempty sign fractions, and the exact all-pairs >10 selection of 80 genes. Empty sign agreement stays undefined rather than zero.

All overlap counts identify the two substantive intersections, whose coefficient views show magnitude and signed agreement using all their shared genes. The fraction lane retains denominators, making 62/62 distinct from 1/1. The views therefore answer a real model-description task.

Square cells have crisp seams and lighter zero labels; nonzero counts stay visible. White-edged coefficient markers sit above faint equality guides and clear zero lines. Agreement marks sit above light reference lanes, with readable numerical fractions.

The actual 190 × 112 mm PNG and nominal 96 dpi PDF have square matrix cells, detached lower labels and complete guides. Matrix, coefficient axes and fraction lane are separated; no clipped labels or merged guide text was observed. Actual PDF/SVG/font geometry passes the independent copied-export rerun.

A sequential count scale of 0–65 includes the observed maximum of 62 and labeled zeros. Blue identifies shared-count and coefficient marks rather than falsely encoding pathway categories. The paper uses signed Wald/perturbation quantities; its diverging palette is not applicable to this nonnegative count.

Coefficient units are explicitly named, equality guides are not fitted lines, and zero lines decode signed coefficients. Italic CXCL8 now sits above its actual target in reopened pass 3, while DUSP6 remains clear. Every fraction shows its denominator; the separate caption explains structural zeros and selection.

external_checks.evidence: Separate actual-export validator rerun on a copied output checks PDF/SVG 190 × 112 mm and PNG dimensions/DPI; current packet artifact hashes were individually verified.
The actual nominal PDF preview was opened and the copied-export validator checks actual embedded Arial 8 pt fonts, glyph coverage and label bounds. No font size or canvas reduction is assumed.

Independent workbook XML audit verifies every one of 11,143 literal coefficient strings and source addresses against the copied official workbook hash; no plot.py import. Every current packet artifact file hash was checked.

The independent audit recomputes support/sign/overlap/selection and actual 80 SVG point centers. Separate export validation checks all vector/PDF/font data on a copied directory. Current rather than prior final hashes are recorded in numeric-evidence.json.

Actual caption read: structural zero versus missing, unscaled signed coefficients, >10 selection, all remaining genes retained, undefined empty-pair agreement, explicit denominators, no replication/inference/causal/activity claim, source DOI and CC BY attribution.
